channel.title: Tampa Bay News Monitor
channel.description: Press releases and breaking news, Tampa Bay

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Deaths and damage reported as severe weather in the Midwest spawns tornadoes and flash flooding
item.description: First responders rescued people from floodwaters Wednesday as utility crews cleared trees and wires downed by severe storms in the Midwest that unleashed tornadoes, heavy rains and flash flooding.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Flock camera vandalism: Surveillance devices damaged in St. Petersburg, Sarasota
item.description: Flock cameras in St. Petersburg and Sarasota were damaged over the weekend, leaving both devices offline.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] 68 drivers caught speeding in Bradenton school zones on first day
item.description: Bradenton police caught 68 drivers speeding through school zones on the first day of school, marking an increase in traffic violations compared to last year.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] K9 Ace becomes first canine patient saved by Tampa General Aeromed
item.description: K9 Ace is retiring at home after emergency air responders flew him to Manatee County veterinary hospital after he was shot by a suspect during a shootout in Polk County.
